thread:
Nia (People Ops): Quick thread for new contractor Priya N. starting next Mon (4/19). She's US-based but currently out of state and will start remotely. We need to schedule I-9 exception process + laptops.

Omar (Recruiter): Priya can't make it to SF for 2 weeks. She requested a shipped laptop. She already completed the web I-9 Section 1. What's the safest path for Section 2?

Sam (Facilities): Reception can accept pickup for a named authorized rep. If shipping, we need a signature and asset acceptance doc signed by Priya.

Caleb (IT): We can ship with an asset packet including a PDF to e-sign (DocuSign). Once signed, we'll release. Asset tag set to B77531. Will preload company VPN cert and standard build.

hr-bot: Background check vendor: CLEARCHECK status: COMPLETE - no hits. Employment verification pending.

Nia (People Ops): Because BG cleared, we're OK to ship once signed asset agreement received. For the I-9, let's offer two options and let Priya choose: authorized representative or notary. Outline below.

Nia (People Ops): ```I-9 remote options for Priya:
1) Authorized Representative:
- Priya names an agent in the Authorized Representative form
- Agent meets the original ID and completes Section 2 at local facility or reception
- Agent signs and returns scanned Section 2 to hr@redwood.com
- People Ops files the exception and schedules in-person verification within 3 business days if/when Priya visits SF

2) Notary option:
- Priya completes Section 1 online
- A notary completes Section 2 with originals and notarizes the document
- Notarized scan sent to People Ops and physical mailed if required
```

Omar (Recruiter): I'll ask Priya which flow she prefers and provide the Authorized Rep template + DocuSign link. Also I'll confirm shipping address.

Caleb (IT): Once DocuSign completes, I'll trigger shipping and send tracking to Priya. We'll include tamper-evident seal and clear instructions for asset acceptance and returns.

Sam (Facilities): Reminder: Never accept packages with ID scans in them. All ID scans must go to secure HR only.

Nia (People Ops): Thanks. I'll monitor the DocuSign and I-9 status. Will keep thread updated. :raised_hands:
